releaseNote.summary: Start, transition, event, retry, ack and SubFlow relay runs survive an HTTP client disconnect; compensation has its own bounded token, so instances are not stranded Busy.

knownIssues.title: If the run token itself is cancelled while the run owns Busy - host shutdown (ApplicationStopping) or the WorkflowExecution:TransitionJobTimeoutSeconds budget (default 300 s) - the pipeline stops midway and the instance can be left Busy with no owner. A client disconnect no longer causes this; only these two causes remain, and there is no automatic recovery.
knownIssues.workaround: Recover a stranded instance manually with the reserved cancel/exit transition.
